spans.text: Clinical Dementia Rating scale

description.value: The Clinical Dementia Rating scale was used to confirm absence of dementia in healthy controls; all controls scored 0.

spans.text: Addenbrooke’s Cognitive Examination-Revised

description.value: The Addenbrooke’s Cognitive Examination-Revised was used as a general measure of cognitive functioning and to confirm healthy control status; all controls scored 88 or above.

spans.text: cognitive assessment
Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Task

description.value: Delayed verbal episodic recall was measured using the Rey Auditory Verbal Learning Task.
Three-minute recall of the Rey Complex Figure was used as an index of non-verbal episodic retrieval.

spans.text: Sydney Language Battery

description.value: Semantic processing was assessed using the Naming, Comprehension, and Semantic Association subscales of the Sydney Language Battery.
Trail Making Test Parts A and B were used to measure psychomotor speed and mental flexibility, respectively.
Digit Span forward and backward were used to assess basic attention and working memory, respectively.

spans.text: Frontotemporal Dementia Rating Scale

description.value: The Frontotemporal Dementia Rating Scale was used to determine functional status and stage dementia-related functional impairment.

spans.text: Memory and Temporal Experience Questionnaire

description.value: Participants generated personally relevant past and future events and non-personal public past and future events. Episodic responses were scored for event, place, and time details; semantic responses were scored for plausibility and detail.

instructions.value: Participants responded extemporaneously to questions; general prompts were provided and no time limit was imposed.

stimuli.value: Questions about personally relevant past and future events and non-personal public events and issues.

value: Episodic event, place, and time detail scores
Percentage correct performance for episodic and semantic past and future subscales
